svg.title: Structure of a remnant in the snowplough phase
svg.desc: Sketch of the pressure p/p_max, in red, and of the density rho/rho_max, in black, against r/r_sh. The pressure is constant in the hot bubble that fills the interior and drops at the shell. The density is low in the interior and rises to a narrow peak, the cold shell, just inside r/r_sh = 1, which moves outwards at speed v_shell, about U_sh. Outside the shell the density is that of the ISM.

g.font-family: 'Latin Modern Math', 'STIX Two Math', 'Cambria Math', serif
